message.content:
Total unordered pairs of vertices:

\[
\binom{20}{2}=190
\]

A segment between two vertices lies strictly inside the dodecahedron unless the two vertices lie on the same face, in which case the segment lies on the surface.

Count vertex-pairs that lie on a common face. Each pentagonal face has

\[
\binom{5}{2}=10
\]

vertex-pairs, so over 12 faces there are

\[
12\cdot 10=120
\]

face-pair incidences. Adjacent vertices forming an edge are counted twice, since each edge belongs to 2 faces. A dodecahedron has

\[
\frac{12\cdot 5}{2}=30
\]

edges. Thus the number of distinct vertex-pairs sharing a face is

\[
120-30=90.
\]

So the number of pairs whose segment lies strictly inside is

\[
190-90=100.
\]

Therefore the probability is

\[
\frac{100}{190}=\frac{10}{19}.
\]

The answer is \(\frac{10}{19}\).
